narrative.details: As you complete the tasks you're assigned in the war you'll want to talk to Vargus, the blacksmith.  Show him any badges you've earned along the way. He'll provide you with gear to match your level of commitment to our cause.
narrative.objectives: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Kaldon sent you? Very well, let's see what we can do for you.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 3,950 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

quests.name: Stalwart's Battlegear
quests.objectiveText: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
